notes.title: 1.1 Is Live
notes.content:
Hi all! First one of these, feels weird to be posting to a Steam Page and not a social media account or something, this is all so new to me!

Anywho! Bit of an update today!

ːpraisesunː We've released Version 1.1! ːpraisesunː

[h1]Here's the patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]ADDED [/b]Controls before entering the Gallery to make movement more clear
[*] [b]ADDED [/b]some simple tips before entering the gallery too.
[*] [b]ADDED [/b]Controls before entering the Bubble Frog DX ROM
[*] [b]ADDED [/b]the ability to ALT+Enter to toggle between Full Screen and Window Mode [i](I gather window mode is super useful for Streamers!)[/i]
[*] [b]ADDED [/b]credit to the awesome Mooon.Bit who's help made Bubble Frog DX even possible!
[*] [b]FIXED [/b]a typo on the Executive Producers list.
[*] [b]FIXED [/b]the mouse pointer breaking free of the game and causing all kinds of issues in the Gallery for Mouse and Keyboard users.
[*] [b]FIXED [/b]Some Portraits and Fanart not showing up correctly when their info plate was examined.
[/list]

Hope this makes the game more accessible to everyone! :D

Also the game is able to go live on Steam for Sale as soon as it has been approved by Steams review process, so it won't be long till everyone gets access to the game! Wheeeee!

-Timbo
